name: Needle Ridge
design_intent:
NEEDLE RIDGE — THE HIGH WIRE #16 (tier 3, razor ridge, max exposure). A single 1000px RAZOR-thin trampoline ridge (h48) over a deep dusk void, flanked by two spring perches 640px OUT (whose outer edges sit only ~460px inside the side blast lines), with one central spring throne (+520). The most exposed stage in the circuit: the ridge is a needle, the perches hang at the very brink of the side blast, and the throne is a boost-only apex over the void. Everything happens on the edge of the abyss. kill_shape = void_is_floor. Signature: the_spine pushed to its razor extreme (thinner ridge, perches closer to the blast). Feel = 'balance on the needle; a single clean line, a ring-out a half-boost away in every direction.'

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; drift ~395 trampoline / ~527 spring MAX; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 640px in ~0.9s @ ~24 fuel; super 2800 clears all). Ridge trampoline x0..1000 top880; left spring perch x-920..-640 top880; right spring perch x1640..1920 top880; throne spring x330..670 top360:
- REACH the LEFT/RIGHT perch: ridge-end-to-perch = 640px of open void each side. 640 > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED both directions; a spring bounce off a perch drifts at most ~527px and drops into the void, so even leaving a perch needs a boost. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- CLIMB to the THRONE (top y360): 520px above the ridge top (880). Trampoline apex 270 reaches only y610 -> 270px short; an under-shot drops off the thin ridge into the void. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY (+ SUPER). (Rule B, >= 520.)
- RECOVER: ridge bottom 928 -> bottom blast line 1620 = 692px of recovery sky (>= 650, Rule D, deliberately tight — this is THE exposed stage) -> a mid-ridge fuelled player fights back, but the perches sit only ~460px inside the side blast, so a knock OUTWARD off a perch is a fast, barely-recoverable ring-out. Verb: FLY.
- No bounce clears a 640px perch gap or the 520px throne climb, so the jetpack is required to move at all. The razor ridge gives no safe runway, yielding the circuit's highest kill-per-exchange. Vertical AND horizontal distance are the entire level, not scenery.
